experiments.title: LAMMPS · GPU-aware scaling
experiments.stack: Record compiler / Cray MPICH / ROCm / driver versions
experiments.baseline: Pin application commit, input hash, allocation, module list, environment and launch command. Capture a known-correct reference; warm up once, then collect at least 3 independent repeats.
experiments.hypothesis: Host staging is limiting strong scaling.
experiments.change: Change only GPU-aware MPI / GTL; hold ranks, nodes and input fixed.
experiments.measurement: Primary metric: end-to-end wall time in seconds (lower is better). Record 3+ repeats, output error vs reference, profiler evidence, queue time, I/O and resource utilization. For serving also capture TTFT, p95 latency, tokens/s and SLO attainment in notes.
experiments.recoveryPlan: Test checkpoint/restart, cancellation, OOM or node loss, timeout, cleanup, logging, scheduler accounting and resource binding. Capture recovery time and any lost work.
experiments.tradeoff: Compare node-hours, cost per successful run, portability, operational complexity and failure frequency. Record remaining limitations.
